title: RAYAS-Powerboat Suit
body:
Axcel Rayas Powerboat Suit – Kevlar Lined

The Axcel Rayas Powerboat Suit is designed for competitive powerboat racing where durability, mobility, and cut protection are essential. Built with a Kevlar-lined interior and a race-focused fit, the Rayas provides consistent protection and comfort in high-speed racing environments.

Each Rayas suit is constructed to meet APBA and UIM requirements and is offered in multiple layer and material configurations, allowing racers to select the setup that best fits their racing conditions and safety preferences.

Suit Options

Rayas (2 Layer) FR Cotton – Kevlar Lined Suit

  • 1 layer FR cotton exterior

  • 1 layer Kevlar lining for cut resistance

Rayas (2 Layer) Nomex – Kevlar Lined Suit

  • 1 layer Nomex exterior

  • 1 layer Kevlar lining for cut resistance

Rayas (3 Layer) FR Cotton – Kevlar Lined Suit

  • 1 layer FR cotton exterior

  • 2 layer Kevlar lining for increased cut protection

Rayas (3 Layer) Nomex – Kevlar Lined Suit

  • 1 layer Nomex exterior

  • 2 layer Kevlar lining for increased cut protection

Built with consistent construction and fit across all configurations, the Axcel Rayas Powerboat Suit delivers dependable performance and protection for racers who need gear they can trust on the water.

Please allow 3–4 weeks for delivery.

title: CAMPANELLA Powerboat Suit

xcel Campanella Powerboat Suit – Kevlar Lined

The Axcel Campanella Powerboat Suit is designed for competitive powerboat racing, offering durable construction, reliable cut protection, and a secure race-ready fit. Each Campanella suit features a Kevlar-lined interior and is available in multiple layer and material configurations to meet different racing and safety requirements.

All Campanella suits are built to meet APBA and UIM requirements and are intended for high-speed racing environments where protection and comfort matter.

Suit Options

title: SFI Axcel Bratos Suit
body:
SFI Axcel Bratos Suit – SFI Certified

Designed for comfort and freedom of movement, the Axcel Bratos combines fire-resistant construction with practical, driver-focused features.

  • Three fabric options: Choose from three fire-resistant textiles.
  • Flexible construction: 360° flex arm panels and a lower-back flex gusset enhance comfort and mobility.
  • Shoulder epaulettes: Designed to assist with emergency extraction.
  • Layer options: Available in single, double, or triple-layer construction.
  • Boot-cut legs: Feature fire-resistant inner cuffs.
  • Convenient storage: Two front pockets.
  • Comfortable closure: Soft-knit collar with a Velcro closure and premium YKK zipper.
  • SFI certified: Choose your SFI rating needed when ordering.
  • Please refer to the attached sizing chart to ensure proper fit.

Please Allow 3 to 4 Weeks For Delivery

title: Axcel GT Drag Racing Suit – SFI 3.2A/15 and SFI 3.2A/20
body:
The Axcel GT Drag Racing Suit is built for drivers who want high heat protection with a clean, aggressive design. Engineered with multi layer Nomex materials and Axcel’s trusted construction, the GT delivers comfort, mobility, and safety for competitive drag racers running demanding heat classes.

Available in both one piece and two piece versions, the GT offers strong thermal protection, a performance focused fit, and a modern style that stands out in the staging lanes.

Features

  • Available in SFI 3.2A/15 and SFI 3.2A/20 fire protection

  • Offered in one piece or two piece configurations

  • Multi layer Nomex construction for high level thermal resistance

  • 360 degree floating arm design for improved upper body mobility

  • Stretch rear panel for increased comfort during staging and driving

  • Clean GT styling with modern panel shapes

  • Reinforced seams and durable YKK hardware

  • Boot cut leg with FR inner cuff for additional heat defense

  • Shoulder epaulettes for assisted emergency extraction

The GT suit delivers proven drag racing protection packaged in an aggressive, streamlined Axcel design.

Sizing: Adult XXS to 4XL
Custom sizing available on request
